fix_decisions.evidence: AC2 mandates forbidding the workaround family BY NAME (copy-into-vendor, chmod, heredoc/interpreter re-invocation, path-prefix variants); trimming the enumeration would violate AC2. Also SKILL.md has 4 bytes of headroom under the 61,750-byte ceiling.

parking_evidence.basis: the enumeration is an AC2 requirement, not a cost overrun to trim
parking_evidence.failing_input: the four named workaround forms AC2 requires
